input_generator: per row: level U(10,500) + trend U(-0.05,0.2)*t + amplitude U(1,30)*sin(2*pi*t/P + phase U(0,2pi)), P in {24,48,96,168}, + N(0, U(0.5,3)) noise; numpy default_rng(seed), rows drawn in (item, variate) order. pattern 'missing' (row r, r % 5): 0 clean; 1 ten scattered NaN; 2 NaN over t in [640,704) (two fully missing patches) plus scattered; 3 the first 90 steps NaN (backfill: patch 2 has 6 observations); 4 NaN in the last context patch [T-20,T-10) plus a fully missing patch at [1024,1056). NaN -> mask False, value 0. mix 'realistic' (the bench, single-series and GluonTS goldens, PLAN section 9): per row a kind drawn from REALISTIC (rw_seasonal 0.35, intermittent 0.15, level_shift 0.15, multi_seasonal 0.15, smooth_trend 0.10, spiky 0.10) unless the case forces one; level 10^U(-2,4), negative for 20 % of rows, unit |level| * U(0.05,0.5); random-walk, seasonal and level-shift kinds add Gaussian noise at SNR ~ 1 (std x U(0.7,1.4)); intermittent = Bernoulli(U(0.02,0.3)) x Poisson(U(1,20)); multivariate items mix a shared latent series (weight U(0.3,0.9)) into each variate. See _realistic() for the exact draws; seeds per case below.
